Spiich Labs (Stockholm) | Founding Design & Frontend Engineer | Full-time | On-site | Visa Sponsorship

We're building Cursor for sales - an AI assistant doubling sales productivity by handling prospecting, CRM updates, meeting prep, and follow-ups.

Backed by founders & operators @ Lovable, OpenAI, Neo4j, Creandum. Pre-seed. Shipping fast.

What you’ll do:

- Own UI/UX of an AI sales assistant end-to-end: research, design & final code

- Develop fast, accessible, and delightful to use pixel perfect interfaces across web, mobile & desktop

- Ship fast, test ideas with users & use data to kill your darlings

Current stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind

Comp: Competitive base + meaningful early equity (flexible structure)

Apply: hello@spiich.ai — LinkedIn, GitHub/portfolio, why Spiich, and your proudest shipped work.

http://spiich.ai
